learning.title: Reject symlinked promotion JSON before import
learning.claim: Python pathlib Path.is_symlink identifies symbolic links. A staged knowledge promotion importer that reads *.json entries without checking for symlinks can follow an entry outside the promotions directory. Reject symlinked promotion entries before parsing to keep out-of-scope JSON from entering the canonical catalog and learning ledger.
learning.decision: PROMOTION_SYMLINK_FAIL_CLOSED_GATE: Reject every symlinked *.json entry in knowledge/promotions before parsing, even if its target contains valid promotion JSON. Verify no canonical source/learning changes and require branch CI/read-back before merge.
learning.next_measurement: Run tests.test_knowledge_promote and complete PR #326 CI at the new HEAD; inspect main read-back, keep promotion staged until reviewed and safely integrated.
failure_history: Before this fix scripts/knowledge_promote.py::_apply_batch parsed all *.json paths without rejecting symbolic links, allowing out-of-scope targets to be considered for import.
fallback_history: If CI or merge is blocked, leave this promotion staged on existing draft PR #326, retain canonical history, and reuse bridge_failure issue #308 with SHA and tests.
